name: Outgrow
summary: Interactive content builder for quizzes, calculators, polls and assessments. Generate and qualify leads with engaging, no-code experiences, then sync them straight into Klaviyo via OAuth for email/SMS follow-up, into Attio for CRM handoff, or into CleverTap, where each answer maps to a field you choose and the lead lands as a contact or in a segment. CleverTap connection read on outgrow.co, 22 Sep 2026.
best_for: marketers who want quizzes, calculators and assessments that earn the lead by giving genuine value — with logic, integrations and templates handled
skip_if: a simple form or survey does the job (Typeform-class is cheaper), or your traffic would blow through the lead caps
honest_knock: Two meters at once: content types and pieces gate the lower tiers, and monthly LEAD limits gate the upside. Read the caps rather than the prices — Freelancer Limited allows 250 leads a month, Freelancer Pro 1,000, Essentials 7,500 and Business 50,000 — because per lead, Essentials and Business cost almost the same and the real jump in value is from Pro to Essentials. Also note what money does not fix: Outgrow's branding stays on every plan below Essentials, comes off there only under the small-business programme, and a custom domain is Business-only at $600 a month. Interactive content genuinely converts better than static forms, but only when the calculator or quiz gives real value; a thin quiz wrapped around a lead form fools nobody.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-06 and again 2026-09-30 on the vendor's own pricing page) Freelancer Limited $22/month or $14 annually for 5 content pieces, 5 content types and 250 leads a month; Freelancer Pro $45/$25 for 7 pieces, 7 types and 1,000 leads; Essentials $115/$95 for unlimited pieces, 9 types, 3 users and 7,500 leads; Business $720/$600 for unlimited pieces, all types, 10 users and 50,000 leads. Annual billing is advertised as saving up to 44%. Three tiers our earlier reading missed sit alongside these: a free Forms/Surveys plan at $0 with 100 leads a month, Startup Basic at $55/$35 ('only new companies can apply') with 750 leads, and Startup Special at $85/$55 ('only startups and small businesses can apply') with 8 content types, 6 pieces and the same 1,000-lead cap as Freelancer Pro. Outgrow branding cannot be removed below Essentials, where it comes off only under the small-business programme, and a custom domain via CNAME is Business-only. A done-for-you build service is listed at 'starting from $250 per content piece'. Note that outgrow.co/llms.txt disagrees with the page: it lists Business at $225, mixes monthly and annual rates, and dates itself to 2025.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 30 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We turned a template into a quiz calculator with our test question and fields, published it on Outgrow's own test link, submitted two made-up responses and exported them.
findings: The trial runs on the Business plan (USD 720 a month) for seven days, ending 6 November, with a cap of 100 leads. No card was asked. The plan list shows no free plan; the cheapest is Freelancer Limited at $22 a month, or $14 billed yearly.
Answers given in Preview are not stored; only a published ('Go Live') calculator collects responses. Email alerts for new leads are switched on by default, and both of ours arrived.
On the published page, the lead form came back pre-filled with the previous person's name, email and answers when we opened it again in the same browser.
The full export arrives as an XLSX link by email and under 'Previous Reports'. That link opened without logging in.

The export kept everything we entered exactly: names with accents, our free text with its line break and quotes, custom fields, and 12.10 and 24.20 with the trailing zero. It also records each respondent's city and region.
Template result screens keep their sample numbers ('Your cost: $4000') until you rewrite the formulas.
We found no way to unpublish a calculator short of deleting it. Team roles are Admin, Manager (preselected), Designer and Analyst, with no view-only role.
not_tested: Re-importing responses (no import route for them)
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
